Home / Privacy

Privacy

This site has no accounts, stores nothing you type, and does not track you.

Analytics and cookies

This site does not use analytics or tracking cookies.

The theme preference (light/dark) is kept in your browser’s local storage. It is never sent anywhere.

Submissions

The submission form runs in your browser and sends nothing to our servers: it opens a pre-filled GitHub issue. Issues and pull requests are subject to GitHub’s privacy statement.

Hosting

The site and its API are run on hosting that may log technical request data (such as IP addresses) for security and operations.

A curated, automatically evaluated catalog of neuroscience ontologies, schemas, vocabularies and data standards.
